analogy.rationale: SMO agonists act on the Hedgehog pathway, but these cell lines have low SMO expression and no Hh ligand, so transcriptional response should be weak; the closest reference classes are other Hedgehog-pathway modulators (SMO antagonist, GLI antagonist), with nuclear receptor agonists as weak nonspecific analogs.
